name: Kolmilammi Dance Pavilion
description: A wooden tanssilava by Kolmilammi pond. Live humppa and tango on summer Sundays, and an ice-cream kiosk by the gate.
greeting: The band is tuning up: accordion, bass, drums.

hello: Welcome to the lava! Tickets here.
Tonight's band plays tango till midnight.
Dance shoes? Wellies are fine too.
broke: No money, no dance, I'm afraid.
refuse: The band's packing up, come back next week.
dance: Lovely tango. Same time next week?

actions.label: Dance at the lava
actions.description: Humppa, tango and a summer night.

requires.message: Your feet are still sore. The next dance is next week.

do.message: You dance humppa until your shirt is soaked.
Someone asks you for a second tango. Your heart skips.
You step on three different feet. Nobody minds.

requires.message: One cone a week. Doctor's orders.

effects.message: Blueberry ice cream by the pond. Summer in one cone.
